_readme: Single source of truth for every business-specific value in the generated JSON-LD. Values below were taken from the BINM project docs in Google Drive (page copy docs, service streams brief, contractor/invoice records, June 2026 keyword map). Any field left as an empty string or empty array is OMITTED from the generated markup (never emitted as a placeholder) and is listed in output/VALIDATION-REPORT.md.

_sources.identity: The business is marked up as the brand, Building Inspections Near Me, only. The operating company's legal name, ABN and registered office are deliberately NOT included: they identify a different named entity, and schema NAP should match the contact details the site itself publishes. Re-add legalName, identifier.value and address only if BINM publishes them on the site under its own name.
_sources.phone_and_price: 'EXISTING BUILDINGS | BINM', 'RENOVATIONS AND EXTENSIONS | BINM' and 'BUILDING INSPECTIONS MELBOURNE | BINM' page copy docs (June 2026).
_sources.area_served: Four metro location pages live (Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Adelaide); service area widened to Australia-wide per INV-001 line item dated 2 June 2026.
_sources.still_empty: logo, image, email, opening hours and sameAs are empty because no source in Drive records them. Per 'BINM - Strategy Plan', the Google Business Profile and social profiles were still to be created, so these values may not exist yet.

business.name: Building Inspections Near Me
business.description: Building Inspections Near Me (BINM) is an engineer-led building inspection service operating across Australia. Every inspection is conducted by a Chartered Engineer or Licensed Builder at standard inspection rates, so the same site data can be escalated to a formal engineering report or a tribunal-ready expert report without a second inspection.
knowsAbout: Dilapidation surveys and adjoining property protection
Floor level surveys and movement monitoring

_openingHoursHelp: Add entries shaped like { "dayOfWeek": ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"], "opens": "08:00", "closes": "17:00" }. Left empty deliberately: no source records BINM's trading hours. Do not guess; hours in markup must match the website and Google Business Profile.
_aggregateRatingHelp: Only fill this in if genuine, first-party review data is visible on the page itself. Google's review snippet policy prohibits marking up ratings that a visitor cannot see on that page, and self-serving LocalBusiness ratings are ignored.
